# 🧠 Algorithm Correctness Review

## Algorithm and authoritative definition
Cite source and assumptions.

## Implementation under review
File, function and commit SHA.

## Input domain
Attribute types, labels, dimensions and edge-case rules.

## Invariants
List the properties expected after each operation.

## Hand-worked fixtures
Include minimal examples and expected boundaries/predictions.

## Comparison
Explain where the implementation agrees or diverges from the definition.

## Complexity and numerical stability
Analyze time/space and floating point issues.

## Evaluation validity
Describe train/validation/test separation and leakage risks.

## Verdict
Correct for stated scope / partial / incorrect / not assessed. Include evidence.
